blurb: Guests can embark on action-packed water adventures including guided WaveRunner tours, banana boat rides, parasail adventures, WaveRunner rentals, paddle boarding, and eco tours on the Calusa Spirit. The tours offer opportunities to see dolphins, manatees, stingrays, and other wildlife. The company provides knowledgeable and friendly staff to guide and enhance the experience.
highlights: Wildlife sightings including dolphins, manatees, stingrays, osprey, and reef sharks

quotes.text: Thrilling adventure! My adult daughter and I took the parasailing adventure. The staff and crew were fantastic. I felt I was in good hands the entire trip. The experience itself was incredible, exciting and beautiful. It view was like nothing else and being up so high above it was thrilling! We could see into the water below and saw a couple of reef shark from above. We had gone far from the shore and over the gulf!read moreread less

Great experience parasailing! We had the best time with the Marco Island Water Sports group out of Naples! Our Captain and 1st Mate made our trip fun for our two teenage kids! My husband and I just rode in the boat. They offer pictures captured by the 1st Mate! They were amazing! Never felt rushed, kids had a blast!read moreread less

Amazing experience! Captain Matt and Sonia made the trip on the Calusa Spirit absolutely fun and amazing! Sonia has so much fun knowledge and history of Marco Island and her jokes were hilarious! We saw so many dolphin, manatees, and other wildlif! the shells we collected made great souvenirs. Thank you!read moreread less

Worth it!! My husband and I were looking for something fun to do on our honeymoon and we found it! The crew was fun, laid back and made our first experience phenomenal! The views were amazing! Highly recommend!read moreread less
Absolutely Perfect The trip was absolutely amazing Excellent & very knowledgeable staff. I highly recommend this day trip, you won’t be disappointed.read moreread less

Incredible WaveRunner Tour Had the most incredible afternoon today on the WaveRunner Tour around The Ten Thousand Islands. Our tour guide, Tommy, was super knowledgable and friendly, he was happy to answer any questions we had and made the tour both fun and interesting. We managed to see dolphins, a manatee and lots of different birds including a Osprey. Honestly cannot really describe how amazing the whole experience was. Definitely worth the money and the sunburn!read moreread less

Guided Waverunner Trip is Amazing! Dolphins and manatees included! The entire team here is great to work with! John took our group out in the morning. We were treated to waverunning with dolphins, manatees and other wildlife. There were so many dolphins swimming and playing next to us jumping and showing off! Then cruising through the mangroves and out in the ocean. John was an amazing guide! We will do this again! Thanks John and the team for an amazing experience!read moreread less
